title: Community pharmacy (controlled substances), existing leased space — Guaynabo, zone X
description: We are opening a community pharmacy in an existing leased retail space in Guaynabo. We will dispense prescription medications, including controlled substances. No construction.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises (Q_PHYSICAL_LOCATION) -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0007)
RULE_0094 / RULE_0045: pharmacy + controlled substances -> pharmacist / establishment licensing. (KB: RULE_0016, RULE_0029, RULE_0045, RULE_0094)
RULE_0095: pharmacy -> Salud establishment license. (KB: RULE_0017, RULE_0095)
A pharmacy dispensing controlled substances needs the Departamento de Salud controlled-substances registration (Ley 4-1971 Arts. 302-304; form DS-DI-016). Issued by Salud, not ASSMCA. (KB: RULE_0733)
Dispensing controlled substances also needs a DEA registration per location (21 U.S.C. 822; 21 CFR 1301.11/1301.13, Form 224). (KB: RULE_0734)

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction in the description: RULE_0643-0646 need project_type new_construction/renovation, structural_work or construction_approvals_required.
Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA answered 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm. A coastal-flagged municipio alone must not trigger it.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED; the business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL.depends_on_document_ids = [DOC_PERMISO_UNICO] (patente after the use permit).
